verdict.rationale: AvaTax documents jurisdiction-aware calculation that handles "product taxability differences" without custom rule engines. It also offers AI tax-code recommendations from product descriptions. AI-assisted explanations of how and why tax was calculated give some visibility into each determination. The evidence never addresses SaaS, digital goods or bundled offerings specifically, and the explanation feature is AI analysis rather than published research. missing for 10: explicit SaaS state-by-state taxability rules, digital-goods handling, bundled-offering treatment, visible legal research or citations behind each determination, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy on these hard cases.
